searchText: PSA: it has been merged 🎉 PSA 2: I just added the test vectors links to devnet-0 doc: https://notes.ethereum.org/6wvK1EbQQuyHlZNzCopOyA?view#Spec-changes-for-pectra-devnet-0 i'll try to make it up-to-date. FYI all, this PR is blocked on some testing review (and consequentially, there may be a few minor bugs/typos in the spec still) but, i believe this is the initial scope of electra we should all be focusing on for `pectra-devnet-0` Electra (with EIP-{6110,7002,7521,7549}): https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3668 e.g. here' s the beacon chain spec from that PR https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/376683d935dcaf3604636a1bd382a1412665b0a8/specs/electra/beacon-chain.md For `ExecutionLayerWithdrawRequest` (which replaces `ExecutionLayerExit`), why are we using the validator pubkey instead of the validator index? I think it would make sense to change this because (1) an index is smaller; 8 bytes vs 48 bytes, (2) `process_execution_layer_withdraw_request` uses the pubkey to get the index, and (3) consistency with `VoluntaryExit` which uses validator index. Also, the EIP says that validator index would work too: only reason i could see would be to avoid issues in the event we decide to start reusing the indices although even then, we would roll out that change in a way such that you wouldn't have any problems (and, we should also think about replay protection here and there...) so i'd support moving that field to the index rather than the public key
